apps.localizedDescription: Mangatan is an open-source Flutter app for reading manga and novels, watching anime, and language learning.

versions.localizedDescription:
What's Changed

• Fixed desktop video•player shortcuts intermittently stopping after the controls faded out by preserving keyboard focus inside the player.
• Fixed subtitle dictionary popups mixing stale results during rapid hover lookups and improved dismissal when the native WebView misses mouse•exit events.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/compare/v1.2.15...v1.2.16

Changelog

• Fixed a Windows crash caused by GPU video texture teardown during player navigation.
• Preserved fullscreen mode when automatically advancing to the next episode.
• Updated the iOS source release metadata.

Downloads

• Windows installer and portable ZIP
• Linux x86_64 archive
• macOS Apple Silicon DMG
• Sideloadable iOS IPA

SHA•256 checksum files are included for the desktop packages.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/compare/v1.2.14...v1.2.15

Changelog

• Fixed the repeatable Windows crash when pressing Back from the video player.
• Fixed the same native texture teardown crash when moving to the next or previous episode, including automatic next•episode playback.
• The video texture is now removed from Flutter's render tree and the raster thread is drained before route navigation and player disposal.
• Added lifecycle regression coverage for texture retirement, listener cancellation, and safe player cleanup.

Downloads

• Windows installer and portable ZIP
• Linux x86_64 archive
• macOS Apple Silicon DMG
• Sideloadable iOS IPA

SHA•256 checksum files are included for the desktop packages.

iOS embedded Mihon fix

• Restores UIScene•safe registration for the embedded Mihon, AnkiMobile, torrent server, and Apple Vision OCR Flutter integrations.
• Keeps the embedded Mihon "start", "pause", "stop", and "status" native methods available through "com.selxo.mangatan.embedded_mihon".
• Moves the early native Mihon pause to the UIScene lifecycle while retaining the serialized Dart resume path.
• Includes unsigned iOS build 187, verified by the release workflow's embedded•runtime and IPA checks.

Physical•iPhone validation is still recommended for extension installation and sleep/resume behavior.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/compare/v1.2.7...v1.2.8

What's new

OCR and manga reading

• Added an OCR processing queue with automatic retries and tap•to•retry for failed chapters.
• Added a dedicated, categorized OCR settings screen with active•text and background opacity controls.
• Added AnimeText YOLO textbox detection that can improve text•region detection across OCR engines.
• Added support for the latest Hayai OCR v2 through a configurable local server.
• Added AI panel•by•panel manga navigation with panel and speech•bubble detection.

Player and desktop

• Added customizable player hotkeys in Settings.
• Added direct editing of "mpv.conf" and "input.conf" from Settings.
• Embedded YouTube inside Mangatan on Windows instead of opening it in a separate browser window.

iOS and Mihon extensions

• Added the sideloadable iOS build and on•device Mihon extension bridge.
• Fixed the source bundle ID mismatch by aligning it with "com.selxo.mangatan".
• Improved Mihon bridge recovery when returning to the foreground, including serialized restarts and retry handling.
• Published and pinned an immutable OpenJDK Zero runtime for ordinary signed iOS device builds.
• Updated the iOS runtime plugin to the Mangatan•maintained extension•server fork.

Base application and builds

• Rebased Mangatan onto Mangayomi v0.8.9 while preserving Mangatan•specific features.
• Updated release builds to Flutter 3.47.1.
• Published Windows, macOS, Linux, and unsigned iOS artifacts through GitHub Actions.

Downloads

Choose the archive or installer for your platform from the assets below. The iOS IPA is unsigned and must be sideloaded with your preferred signing method.

**Full changelog:** [v1.2.6...v1.2.7](https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/compare/v1.2.6...v1.2.7)

What's changed

Subtitle appearance
• Added adjustable subtitle textbox background opacity; the previous appearance remains the default.
• Added font•weight, outline•thickness, shadow•thickness, shadow•blur, and shadow•offset controls with live preview.

Subtitle browsing
• Reworked the video subtitle list to behave more like Memento, including active•cue tracking, search, delay•aware timestamps, and more direct seeking.

Dictionaries and upstream
• Updated HoshiDicts integration and generated bindings.
• Rebased the fork onto Mangayomi v0.8.5 while retaining Mangatan's iOS and language•learning features.

Reliability and packaging
• Repaired stale Riverpod, Isar, localization, and plugin outputs left by the upstream rebase.
• Restored reader, local archive, extension, and platform integrations affected by the rebase.
• Fixed iOS embedded•Mihon tests and packaging while preserving lazy OpenJDK loading.
• Aligned Flutter, Rust bridge, Windows, CocoaPods, and dependency versions for reproducible release builds.
• Restored reliable Windows native builds with short build paths and an explicit Rust prebuild.

Release builds
• iOS sideload IPA
• macOS arm64 DMG
• Windows installer and portable ZIP
• Linux x86_64 archive
• SHA•256 checksum manifests

Version 1.2.5, build 177.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/compare/v1.2.3...v1.2.5

What's new

• Added local Mihon extension APK import and reconciled factory sources with synced repositories.
• Made Chimahon downloads authoritative while preserving audio and subtitle track languages, with an audio fallback for decoder failures.
• Improved reader playback and page•position persistence, subtitle OCR timing, rendered•bitmap OCR, Apple Vision OCR, and OCR box opacity alignment.

Downloads

• **iOS:** unsigned sideload IPA, build 173
• **Windows:** installer and portable ZIP
• **macOS:** Apple silicon DMG
• **Linux:** x86_64 archive
• SHA•256 checksum files are attached for desktop packages.

Release commit: "e4a8e92d"

What's new

• Added Mihon v2 extension repository support, including gzip•compressed protobuf ("index.pb") catalogs, "repo.json" pointers, separate extension lists, and repository•provided APK/icon URLs.
• Existing legacy "index.min.json" repositories remain supported.
• Rebased Mangatan on the latest Mangayomi 0.8.2 sources while preserving Mangatan's on•device iOS Mihon bridge, OCR, mining, dictionary, reader, and sync features.
• Included upstream player control scrolling improvements, the Google Fonts CPU•usage fix, safer/faster MPV configuration extraction, the updated source catalog, and the official repository safety warning.
• Added the manual reader OCR trigger: select **Manual** for **OCR trigger** to scan the current page only when the OCR button is pressed. Automatic mode remains the default.

Mihon repository setup

You can now add the current Keiyoushi protobuf catalog directly:

"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keiyoushi/extensions/repo/index.pb"

Downloads

• **iOS:** unsigned sideload IPA, build 172
• **Windows:** installer and portable ZIP
• **macOS:** Apple silicon DMG
• **Linux:** x86_64 archive
• SHA•256 checksum files are attached for desktop packages.

Release commit: "6da05f6f7"

﻿Highlights

Latest Mangayomi foundation

• Rebased Mangatan onto the latest Mangayomi "main", bringing AniList discovery and franchise watch•order navigation.
• Added stronger download controls with per•source serialization, configurable concurrency and rate limits, queue reordering, cancellation, connection timeouts, and stall recovery.
• Added saved searches, optional source badges, source filtering, cancellable library updates, and fixes for duplicate chapters and episodes.
• Improved Android TV navigation and scaling, mobile player controls and resume behavior, tracker reliability, offline novel chapters, and reader image loading.
• Added the native subsampling image decoder for Windows and Linux and refreshed extension sources to v0.8.1.

Mangatan improvements

• Added animated AVIF mining support on desktop.
• Fixed cross•platform local•media playback and playback media analysis.
• Added Arch Linux support for the embedded Mihon extension server and packaged it for the AUR.
• Added project screenshots and a link to Chimahon in the README.
• Preserved Mangatan's iOS sideloading, embedded Mihon, mining, dictionary, OCR, and reader customizations while integrating upstream.

Packaging

• Version: "1.2.0" (build 170).
• Release commit: ["fe18e7252"](https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/commit/fe18e725242e3d925d0a795233c0d5af946f9f64).
• Desktop artifacts are available below; the iOS sideload workflow publishes its IPA separately.
• AUR publishing covers both "mangatan•bin" and "mangatan•extension•server".

Included Mangatan changes

• ["8f569f6e0"](https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/commit/8f569f6e0) • Add desktop animated AVIF mining ([70](https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/pull/70))
• ["5569705c3"](https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/commit/5569705c3) • Fix the Mihon extension server on Arch Linux and package it for the AUR ([71](https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/pull/71))
• ["f69787a74"](https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/commit/f69787a74) • Add screenshots and link to Chimahon ([73](https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/pull/73))
• ["ce3fbaf4b"](https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/commit/ce3fbaf4b) • Fix cross•platform local•media playback
• ["abdd5672d"](https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/commit/abdd5672d) • Fix playback media analyzer lint
• ["f1b128754"](https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/commit/f1b128754) • Merge the latest upstream Mangayomi "main"
• ["fe18e7252"](https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/commit/fe18e7252) • Prepare the "v1.2.0" release

**Full tagged diff:** https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0

Highlights

YouTube and mining

• Reworked YouTube browsing to match Chimahon's web•first design: Mangatan opens the real YouTube site instead of presenting a replacement search•results screen.
• Added interception for watch, Shorts, live, embed, and "youtu.be" links, including YouTube single•page•app navigation, then hands the original page URL to Mangatan's mining•capable player.
• Added NewPipe Extractor v0.26.3 resolution through M•Extension•Server v1.0.6.0 on iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux, restoring separate audio streams and qualities above the 360p muxed fallback.
• Fixed intercepted video clicks that could appear to do nothing, and return to the actual YouTube watch page when extraction rejects a video.
• Preserved preferred quality selection, captions, alternate audio tracks, video OCR, sentence audio, and Anki mining in the full player.
• Fixed YouTube video/channel records failing with "IsarError: Write operations require an explicit transaction".
• Added browser playback shutdown, duplicate•launch protection, cookie support, back navigation, and safe browser•window lifecycle handling.

Dictionaries and kanji lookup

• Redesigned Yomitan kanji results into a compact Meaning, Readings, and Statistics layout while preserving classifications, codepoints, dictionary indices, and source labels.
• Added popup navigation with Page Up/Down, arrow keys, Home/End, and hardware volume keys, including E•Ink•compatible instant scrolling.
• Added shared dictionary lookup history across manual, recursive, subtitle, and manga•reader lookups.
• Added safe dictionary display•name aliases plus Yomitan•compatible revision checks, manual updates, and configurable automatic updates.

OCR, subtitles, and readers

• Added selected•chapter pre•OCR, configurable parallel OCR tasks, in•reader OCR•engine switching, and stable OCR progress while changing pages.
• Added two•finger OCR toggles for touch manga and video readers.
• Added subtitle cleanup filters for speaker labels, bracketed text, uppercase cues, music markers, multiline merging, and custom regular expressions.
• Added manga E•Ink mode and a thumbnail page•preview grid with direct page jumps.
• Added HEIC, HEIF, and JPEG XL discovery and MIME handling for local manga, archives, and EPUB content alongside existing AVIF support.

Extensions and local libraries

• Restored manga•extension icons when retired Keiyoushi icon URLs return 404 by deriving icons from repository metadata and falling back to the maintained Yuzono manga repository.
• Applied icon recovery consistently to source lists, extension lists, filters, TV rows, and extension details.
• Fixed custom local manga folders on Windows drives other than "C:" and improved multi•folder rescanning.

iOS, Anki, and embedded Mihon

• Added an iOS choice between AnkiMobile callbacks and AnkiConnect while preserving desktop AnkiConnect behavior.
• Made the embedded Mihon listener recover after suspension, stale•listener detection, and not•yet•ready startup states.
• Refreshed transient Mihon image tokens, added bounded transient image retries, and guarded reader restoration when a chapter ID is missing.
• Pinned immutable embedded server runtime "ios•runtime•v7", built from M•Extension•Server commit "68645ae7a", with its verified SHA•256.

Packaging and distribution

• Corrected iOS tag•driven release handling and artifact naming.
• Replaced the earlier v1.1.0 artifacts with build 168 from commit ["66c8c5708"](https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/commit/66c8c5708809e81c7e050591693e116995a00448).
• Added automated stable "mangatan•bin" AUR publishing with generated checksums and package metadata.
• Updated release, sideloading•source, and embedded•runtime links to the Mangatan upstream repository.

**Full tagged diff:** https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/compare/v1.0.9...v1.1.0

What's changed

• Added [Chimahon•compatible immersion statistics](https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/pull/65), including novel and manga reading tracking, Anki mining stats, reader statistics sheets, backup, and sync support.
• Added Yomitan kanji dictionary imports and Yomitan•style kanji lookup by selecting a kanji inside a word popup.
• Fixed dictionary WebView refresh after theme, language, and dictionary changes.
• Fixed marking multiple selected manga or novel chapters as unread.
• Fixed bookmarks so they follow the chapter currently being read instead of the chapter originally opened.
• Added the novel reader Text Size control to reader settings.
• Added AVIF page support and preserved OCR loading progress when changing pages.
• Improved iOS sideload and Mihon bridge compatibility, and added Linux release packaging.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/compare/v1.0.8...v1.0.9
